venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Wednesday 9/9 (MOD Jk).** Missed target: net $832 vs $1,547 target (-46%). 27 guests, $30.83 check avg, $21 comps, $76 food. Quiet Wednesday — no sales until ~5:45pm; opener sent home ~7pm. Team continuing garnish focus. Tomorrow kicks off the first Football Thursday (Joe's specials post; word of mouth until table tents arrive). Kitchen had lots of downtime — good prep going into the week. No 86s, no maintenance needs, no incidents. Favorite moment: telling guests about Football Thursday. Entered by Mya.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Wednesday 9/9 (MOD KK & MD / Chef JMS).** Missed target: net $722 vs $1,507 target (-52%). 31 guests, $23.28 check avg, $85.05 comps (11.8% — gift, marketing, bingo credit, F&F, industry), $51 food. Slower-paced Wednesday; continued heat advisory and post-holiday weekend likely dampened volume. Majority of guests were first-timers and highly complimentary. Consistent flow of service to close. Kitchen: John Michael held it down. Maintenance: well 1 soda tap handle. No incidents. Favorite moment: first-time guest Kyle, chatted spirits and cocktails, insistent he'll return. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.weather: Second night with a gorgeous sunset sky
venues.narrative: **DVR — Wednesday 9/9 (AM: Evan / PM: Maggie H).** Missed target: net $6,862.61 vs $9,894 target (-31%). 176 guests (Tock), $385.55 comps, $1,502.80 food. Splits: DC/AM $782.72, D&C PM $6,079.89, Garden/6A $1,341.90. No events. AM: easy-going Wednesday, usual regulars all day; fresh miel and peach cardi batches; 86 French dip, coconut milk. PM: slow until 9pm, Madi cut early, Kim out on time — not enough of a pop to hit goal after a sleepy first six hours. Garden (Sam solo): chill, lots of friends stopped by; Octopus sake rotating; 86 wooden forks; under-bar light breaker tripped (Carey logged in Intelliity); grapefruit juice running fast with kegged Paloma out — grab backup deli if still out this weekend; garnish-prep reminder list for new prep staff. Kitchen: light post-Labor Day food night, praise for family meal; light prep (agnolotti dough, burger portions half-prepped till Friday); low on crudo scallops, basil vinaigrette, lemon aioli, chicken breast; 86 tart shells, scallops, succotash. No no-shows charged, no incidents. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Wednesday 9/9 (MOD Seth + Steves).** Just missed target: net $4,771 vs $4,951 target (-4%). 126 guests (SevenRooms), $38 check avg, $184.84 comps (3.87%), $508 food / $4,262 beverage, no retail, no events. Chill, decently paced start; got disjointed ~10pm when all large parties (two 9-tops) arrived 20–30 min late — team made the seating puzzle work (shoutout Haleigh on the door, Stefania and Max). Steady flow 8–11pm with walk-ups keeping momentum till midnight. Notable guests: Christina and husband commemorating a late brother (team signed his Modern Classics book, visiting all locations), Brisbane-location fans, Philly regulars, Nicholas Gamble +5; industry: Braxton, Koba, Alexis Duarte (Derumbes), Curtis Allumbaugh, Evan Saez. Top sellers: Rosalie, Native Lion, Bell & Vine, Cookies. 86 oysters. Breakage: 1 coupe, 2 DOF chipped. No-show: Purti Pancholi 6 @ 11pm (not charged). Maintenance: leak above bathroom door. No incidents. Entered by MK.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Wednesday 9/9 (MOD Julian & Saleh).** Beat target: net $5,858 vs $892 target as entered (target looks mis-keyed; Wed targets have run ~$4–5k). 143 guests, $40.97 check avg, $237.52 comps (handful of DNLs, a couple members, employee discounts), $1,075 food. All Marquee ($5,858 / $1,075 food); Standing Room closed; no events. Busy Wednesday with a small waitlist; Gracey took tables on her own and killed it. ~20 USC students in for a 'speed dating' group, a Temecula couple who loved everything, Suntory rep in the house. Kitchen: Angel's first real shift learning the dash. Maintenance: men's mirror fixed; need standing-room bar top checked for bugs. 86/low: server note pads, St. George dry reposado, candles, honey, cream sherry. No incidents, no no-shows charged. Favorite moment: 'Bar got rocked today.' Entered by Julian Catano.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Wednesday 9/9 (MOD Marcus).** Beat target: net $7,788.06 incl. events vs $3,398 target (+129%). Marquee bar $3,295.97, Garden event $4,797, $258.20 food. 103 guests (event 25, walk-in 51, reso 27). $98.90 comps (member/investor $28.90, service recovery $14, gift $10, DNL $46). Solid Wednesday in the Marquee with pops at 6:30/7:30/8:30 then a steady trickle. Devan ran the floor with Chaz support; Jada and Alex on the bar. Connor's first barback shift — great across both Garden event and Marquee. Chaz cut ~9:30 after Garden breakdown; soft breakdown of the Point by 10; natural last call ~11:20, welcomed one final couple at 11:30. Kitchen: another busy event night, awesome plating; James and Rasaan documenting presentation standards. Highlight: Rasaan made a special tuna crudo for an event guest with dietary restrictions who hadn't eaten all day. Maintenance: curtain rail. No incidents, no no-shows charged. Entered by Marcus.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: Lightly rainy all day, not brutally hot
venues.narrative: **MG — Wednesday 9/9 (AM: Sam & Lex / PM: James & Drew).** Beat target: net $4,282 vs $3,950 target (+8%). 113 guests (AM 49 / PM 64, OpenTable), $120 comps, $1,818 food. Splits: AM $1,013, PM $3,241, Sun Club $30, Hot Eye closed. AM: quiet morning, few hotel guests at breakfast, two decent food tours, more midday cocktail drinkers than usual; biggest push 1–2pm. PM: even-keel steady night, staffed up ahead of busy season; Estella trained at host stand with Emma; three servers + SA handled volume easily, Caitee cut early; late pop underwhelming due to weather. Sun Club closed before 3pm for rain (2 drinks sold); restock towels and passion fruit. Kitchen: slow and steady; 86 Romanesco (back tomorrow). Maintenance: persistent vent leak in the men's bathroom at THE; all MG drain lines checked. No incidents. Favorite moment: David Little and wife Jenni staying with us. Entered by James.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Wednesday 9/9 (MOD Julian Abel).** Just missed target: net $9,970 vs $10,000 target (-0.3%). 242 guests, $41.20 check avg, $561.07 comps (shifties $232, service recovery $96), $1,246 food. Slow start on account of the Seahawks game, then ramped up. MOD touched tables and supported the floor; Dave came in to help work the door. Opening/closing sequences getting faster; team much better closing guests out on handhelds. BOH very smooth (thanks Josh and Wes). Negroni Verde back tomorrow; hand-building Brooklyns at reduced price until Leopold Bros lands. No incidents, no no-shows charged. Favorite moment: Frank rocking out to MCR. (Form dated 9/10; matched to 9/9 by post time.) Entered by Julian Abel.
